title: Math Made Thinking
goal: Numbers and rules can act like a tiny brain.
mascot_lines: A long time ago, smart people wondered if numbers and rules could think.
They wrote tiny steps on paper, like a recipe a machine could follow.
Those paper steps were the very first robot brains.
Today, every game and every app still works that same way underneath.

tier2.rephrase: Watch the scene. Then put the math steps in the right order.

tier3.nudge: First we ADD, then we CHECK if it is more than five.
